items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I was married at that time to Escaleda

ctx.x: These people got out in three days.

Yes, very, very lucky and I will never forget what a thrilling thing that was. I went home that night and I was married at that time to Escaleda and we looked in the paper and Art Tatum was playing at the, I think, the Three Deuces or the Downbeat on 52nd Street and we went down of course, to hear this great master, this great artist and they brought for me a bottle of champagne and I remember Art coming over and pouring we poured the champagne over one another, what a wild -- one of the great musical experiences…

It took me a month to make up my mind to take it off and my wife got on me, she said -- I didn't have any clothes, you see, I had to buy some new civilian clothes and I remember going to a place called Paul Stewart's, it was like a small Brooks Brothers and I bought a couple of suits, and the day I took off the uniform I got a call from Ray McKinley who was with Glenn Miller in Europe and he said, Budd, there's a chance to do a show, a radio show called Report to the Nation and a lot of important people on it and…
